title: USA L-1 Visa from the UK | Intracompany Transfer Help
description: USA L-1 visa for managers, executives and specialists transferring to a US branch of their employer. Petition, DS-160 and interview help.
h1: USA L-1 visa (intracompany transfer) from the UK
intro: The L-1 visa lets companies transfer managers, executives (L-1A) and staff with specialised knowledge (L-1B) from a UK office to a related company in the USA.

sections.heading: How the L-1 visa works
sections.text: Your employer first files a petition with US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), or uses an approved blanket L petition. You must usually have worked for the company abroad for at least one continuous year in the last three. You then apply for the visa with the approval and attend an interview.

sections.heading: The US visa interview
sections.text: Most US visas involve the online DS-160 form, paying the visa fee, and an interview at the US Embassy in London or the US Consulate in Belfast. Every answer on the DS-160 must be accurate and match your documents. We prepare your form and tell you what to take to the interview.

sections.heading: L-1 visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the UK. We check the rules for your passport, prepare your application and keep you updated until it's decided.

faqs.a: Your employer, with US Citizenship and Immigration Services, or through an approved blanket L petition.

faqs.q: Can my family come with me?
faqs.a: Spouses and children can usually apply for L-2 visas.

faqs.q: How long does a L-1 visa take?
faqs.a: Processing times vary with the authority and the time of year. Apply as early as you can, and don’t book non-refundable travel until your visa or authorisation is approved.

faqs.q: Can you help with my L-1 visa application?
faqs.a: Yes. We check which visa fits your trip, prepare your L-1 visa application and documents, and keep you updated. Contact us or call 0161 956 2003.
